Container.Name: BrayDashy
Container.Overview: A custom, beautiful, and highly dynamic Unraid landing page dashboard with dual Sysadmin Mode and Home Mode profiles.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the dashboard is accessible on

Config.Name: App Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage folder for your dashboard configuration and profiles.

Config.Name: Release Deploy Folder
Config.Description: Tagged releases from Forgejo (releases/vX.Y.Z, current.json, run.js). Filled by Software/Deployment/unraid-cutover.sh and the in-app updater; never edit by hand.
